caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical composition featuring several geometric and stylized objects rendered primarily in red, gold, and blue. At the top is a stylized cross with rounded, flared ends and blue filigree details inside, outlined in red with gold as the base color. Behind the cross, there are radiating lines resembling rays, also in gold. Beneath the cross is a symmetrical bow or ribbon design with four elongated loop shapes outlined in blue, filled with gold and red dots, and intersecting at a central circular knot. Flanking the bow are two stylized gold shapes, each with two rounded ends and a pointed tip, featuring red semicircular segments; these resemble wings or leaves. Directly below, there is a large circle bordered in red and blue, filled with an intricate, radial pattern composed of twelve pointed shapes alternating in red and gold, with blue outlines and teardrop designs in gold and blue. The background is a mottled parchment-like beige, giving the drawing an aged appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
